methodology.timing_scope: Production analysis and statistics plus instrumentation; excludes report generation, checks and JSON writing
methodology.per_game_scope: analyze_game including process launch and quit; excludes statistics aggregation
methodology.duplicate_scope: Within each run; occurrences after first, not pair counts; no reuse between repetitions
methodology.history_key: binary hash + engine identity + effective UCI configuration + variant + Chess960 + root FEN + full move stack + search limit + kwargs
limitations: No promise of deterministic engine evaluations or timings
Cache opportunity counts do not model warm transposition-table state
Synthetic White-side cohort used for historical multi-game reporting
Warm-up warms host resources; production still starts fresh engines per game
